title: Indoor lab/bench area with netting, blue stools and HKU Engineering barrier tape
objects_and_counts: One standing person is visible near the rear left of the scene; the person is partially obscured by netting and turned sideways (only the torso and legs are clearly visible).
Two blue square/rectangular upholstered stools are visible in the foreground left; both are fully visible and not cropped.
One small white oval table with three visible wooden-coloured legs is in the foreground right and is fully visible.
One grey plastic chair with metal legs is visible behind the green belt, approximately mid-image center-right; the chair is fully visible.
One orange traffic cone is visible on the floor near the mid-right of the image, in front of the beige partition and behind the green belt.

Multiple tall metal stanchion posts with a green retractable belt are visible; at least three posts are distinguishable (one at mid-right, one at mid-center, one at far right) but some posts are partially obscured by netting and cropping.
A large white mesh net spans the foreground and upper parts of the image covering much of the scene; the net is continuous and attached at multiple points.
A shelving or equipment rack unit is visible along the rear left wall containing multiple trays or drawers; parts of the unit are partially obscured by the net.
Two grey sandbag-style weights or base cushions are visible on the floor anchoring parts of the net/stands: one near the mid-right post and one near the mid-center post.
A tripod or stand is visible at the far left edge of the image (partially visible and cropped by the image edge).
Several posters or printed display panels are visible on the left rear area mounted on easels or stands; the content of most posters is partially obscured or not legible.
